summary: Learning to wait, listen, and respond with grace under pressure.

understand.title: Understand patience
understand.body: Patience is not passivity. It is strength under restraint — love that makes room for others.

notice.title: Notice impatience
notice.body: Where do hurry and harshness show up in ordinary moments this week?

practice.title: Practice the pause
practice.body: Choose one daily situation to slow your first response.

practice_under_difficulty.title: Hold form under load
practice_under_difficulty.body: Practice patience when interrupted, delayed, or misunderstood.

apply_in_relationships.title: Patience with people
apply_in_relationships.body: Let patience shape one important relationship this week.

reflect_and_reassess.title: Reflect and reassess
reflect_and_reassess.body: What evidence of growth do you notice? Where is honesty inviting a next season?
